newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease on 0.25 pct repo rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease on 0.25 pct repo rate cut.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates continued Friday's fall after the central bank cut repo rates, traders said on Monday.
"The market is liquid, and there is room for further easing of the overnight rates," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates opened between 23.50 to 24 percent on Monday and finished around 23 percent, compared with Friday's close of 23.75 percent.
Traders said Friday's repo rate cuts came earlier than expected, but the size of the cuts was not surprising.
